title: 第17章 云岫烟第18章 突破同门小会
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
此时晨雾散尽，顾安与云岫烟来到凉亭里坐定，旁边灵眼里的灵气随着水汽蔓延，深吸一口气，只觉灵力充沛，心旷神怡。
“这灵泉眼是我云家这条二阶下品灵脉唯一一口，三叔让给了我。”云岫烟看顾安一双眼直往灵泉眼上飘，有些无奈，出声解释道。
这师弟刚见面就听见在那说着灵石什么的，现在看见灵泉眼又移不开眼，不知在想些什么。
顾安此时也反应过来，收回目光，心中有点尴尬：“怎么看见好东西就走不动道呢，诶，都是穷闹的，还是得多多挣灵石啊！”
腰间储物袋轻振，十三袋灵米先飞出，一玉罐紧随其后。仔细看可以发现，和林路平交给他时相比，第十三袋灵米少了近半，玉罐内的红枫灵液也少了一层。
都经过他顾安的手了，留下层油也很正常吧！再说了，多出那些本来就是林家给他的孝敬，他得多迂腐才会交上去。
“师姐，这是林家今年的灵税，金云米一千二百六十斤，红枫灵液四斤半，您点点。”
云岫烟拿起把金云米一扫眼，看出质量不错，又打开红枫灵液看了看，满意的点了点头，一直没有变化玉面泛起一丝笑容，红唇轻掀。
“师弟倒是老实，比宗门预估的还要多不少，不像你那些师兄，恨不得咬下一块肉来。”
顾安闻言心痛不已，这群蛀虫，太无耻了！！
“师兄们这么大胆吗？我只是刮层油，他们居然直接吃肉。”
“还是吃了老实的亏，明年一定要吸取教训啊。”
云岫烟自是不清楚顾安心中所想，紧接着说道：“不过太老实也不是什么好事，唔，红枫灵液太少，师姐也要用，拿一袋金云米吧。”
说着，一袋金云米飞回顾安的面前。
顾安眨巴着眼睛，脑中一时有些混乱。
他在云岫烟眼里得有多老实啊，竟然主动给回扣。
那师兄们得下手多黑啊！！
还有，宗门没什么意见吗？
怎么没人告诉我啊！
黑！

太黑了！
顾安只觉得天地间一片茫茫黑暗，只有自己出淤泥而不染。
殊不知在云岫烟看来，这位师弟也很奇怪，明明看起来都钻进灵石眼里了，居然对灵税不动心。
她哪知道，顾安已经动了手脚了，可眼界太低，贪的太少，导致她都没发现。
虽然来到这个世界已经十五年，顾安的一些观念也发生改变，可顾安受上一世影响，认知还没彻底改过来，跟不上时代。
简单来说，顾安的道德水平还是太高了！！！
强忍着诱惑，顾安对云岫烟一拱手，小心的说道：“师姐，这不好吧，宗门不会查吗？”
云岫烟却面色不变的说道：“放宽心，宗门不管的，连我师傅都说没事。”
“那就多谢师姐厚爱，师弟却之不恭了。”顾安像吃了颗定心丸，放下心来。
毕竟青霄真人都说没事，那就是真没事。
云岫烟将手中的金云米撒给紫云雁，惹得紫云雁一阵欢腾。
两口将灵米吸入腹中，又跑到云岫烟的脚下蹭来蹭去，看样子是没吃饱。
content_en:
At this time, the morning fog cleared, and Gu An and Yun Xiuyan came to sit in the pavilion. The spiritual energy in the spiritual eyes next to them spread with the water vapor. They took a deep breath and felt full of spiritual energy and relaxed and happy.
"This Lingquan Eye is the only second-level low-grade spiritual vein in my Yun family. My third uncle gave it to me." Yun Xiuyan looked at Gu An with his eyes drifting up to the Lingquan Eye, and explained a little helplessly.
When this junior brother met, he heard people talking about spiritual stones and so on. Now that he saw the spiritual spring, he couldn't move his eyes away. He didn't know what he was thinking.
Gu An also reacted at this time and looked away, a little embarrassed in his heart: "Why can't I walk when I see good things? Hey, we are all poor, so we should earn more spiritual stones!"
The storage bag on the waist vibrated slightly, and thirteen bags of spiritual rice flew out first, followed closely by a jade jar. If you look closely, you can see that compared with when Lin Luping handed it to him, the thirteenth bag of spiritual rice was missing nearly half, and the red maple spiritual liquid in the jade jar was also missing one layer.
It's all passed through his hands, Gu An, so it's normal to leave a layer of oil behind! Besides, he would have to be pedantic to hand over the extra filial piety that was originally given to him by the Lin family.
"Senior sister, this is the Lin family's spiritual tax for this year. It is one thousand two hundred and sixty kilograms of gold cloud rice and four and a half kilograms of red maple spirit liquid. Please order."
Yun Xiuyan picked up a handful of golden cloud rice and glanced at it. She saw that the quality was good. She opened the red maple spirit liquid and looked at it. She nodded with satisfaction. A smile appeared on her jade face, which remained unchanged, and her red lips lightly lifted.
"Junior brother is quite honest. It's much more than the sect expected. It's not like your senior brothers who want to bite off a piece of meat."
Gu An was heartbroken when he heard this. These moths are so shameless! !
"Senior brothers, are you so bold? I just scraped off a layer of oil, but they actually ate the meat directly."
"I still suffered a serious loss. I must learn from it next year."
Yun Xiuyan didn't know what Gu An was thinking, so she immediately said, "But being too honest is not a good thing. Well, there is too little red maple spirit liquid. Senior sister also needs to use it. Let's get a bag of golden cloud rice."
With that said, Mifei, a bag of gold clouds, looked back in front of An.
Gu An blinked, his mind a little confused for a moment.
How honest he must be in Yun Xiuyan's eyes, and he even took the initiative to give him a kickback.
How dark can the senior brothers be? !
Also, does the sect have no objections?
Why didn't anyone tell me?
black!
Too dark!
Gu An only felt that there was a vast darkness between heaven and earth, and he was the only one who could escape from the mud and remain unstained.
However, in Yun Xiuyan's view, this junior fellow apprentice was also very strange. He seemed to have got into the eyes of the spirit stone, but he was not moved by the spirit tax.
She didn't know that Gu An had already done something, but her vision was too low and her greed was too little, so she didn't notice it.
Although it has been fifteen years since he came to this world, some of Gu An's concepts have also changed. However, Gu An was affected by his previous life, and his cognition has not completely changed, and he cannot keep up with the times.
To put it simply, Gu An's moral level is still too high! ! !
Resisting the temptation, Gu An held up his hand to Yun Xiuyan and said carefully: "Senior sister, isn't this bad? Won't the sect investigate?"
Yun Xiuyan said without changing her expression: "Relax, the sect doesn't care. Even my master said it's fine."
"Then thank you, senior sister, for your kindness, but junior brother is disrespectful." Gu An seemed to have taken a reassurance and felt relieved.
After all, Master Qingxiao said it's okay, so it means it's really okay.
Yun Xiuyan sprinkled the golden cloud rice in her hand to Zi Yunyan, which made Zi Yunyan burst into joy.
He sucked the spirit rice into his stomach in two mouthfuls, then ran to Yun Xiuyan's feet and rubbed it. It looked like he wasn't full.
